references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, detailed rules are given about which animals are clean and unclean based on their hooves and chewing of the cud, as verse 26 summarizes.
Describes uncleanness from touching dead animals, directly linked to the warning in verse 26 that whoever touches an unclean animal becomes unclean.
Refers to uncleanness resulting from contact with unclean animals, including carcasses of unclean livestock.
Parallel legislation in Deuteronomy that repeats the rules about clean and unclean animals based on split hooves and chewing of the cud.
Elaborates on the consequences of touching or carrying animal carcasses, connecting to the uncleanness rule in verse 26.
Rules concerning uncleanness from touching dead bodies, expanding the principle of uncleanness through physical contact.
